summary: The first real Aureline operator continuity packets — an outgoing-shift handoff, a client-facing handoff, a daily operations digest, and a private night-shift digest — that preserve, outside the live session, the same object identity, grouping, freshness, ownership, redaction, unresolved questions, and live-versus-cached-versus-mirrored-versus-snapshot truth the operator saw. Digests group by object and severity before chronology and keep each object's latest update and major blocker; every packet reopens onto the canonical object or a truthful placeholder rather than a generic dashboard, declares explicit scope and boundary truth before share/export, and freezes a snapshot export that never flattens the storage/freshness distinction, all bound to the operator-surface matrix.

invariants.statement: Every packet binds its operator-surface matrix family (handoff bundle or shift digest) by the matrix's own surface id.
The set proves both the handoff-bundle and the shift-digest surfaces.
Every group object, evidence ref, question link, and resolvable reopen target is a canonical aureline:// handle.
The set proves all four storage classes — live link, cached, mirrored, and snapshot — and every roll-up counts them separately, never flattening them into one blob.
Every evidence item carries an origin, a captured-at, and live/refresh flags computed from its storage class.
Every digest orders its groups by severity (most severe first) and orders events chronologically only within a group.
Every packet — handoff bundle and digest alike — keeps its groups severity-ordered and its within-group events chronological.
Every group preserves its latest update time and its blocker reason, its severity is the most severe of its events, and the roll-up's latest update is the newest group's.
Every reopen anchor resolves to a canonical object or a truthful placeholder that names what the object was — never a generic dashboard.
The set proves all four reopen-anchor classes — live object, cached snapshot, mirrored offline view, and truthful placeholder.
Every packet carries unresolved questions, each naming an owner, a canonical object, and a next safe action, with a reason when blocked.
Every packet declares a scope and a matching export gate that names what crosses the boundary on share/export and requires acknowledgement above private scope.
The set proves a private, a workspace-shared, and an org-shared packet.
Every packet names an owning role, a decision right, and the target role it is handed to.
Each packet's frozen export equals re-exporting it and is labeled snapshot_only.
Each export preserves the exact object groups (with every evidence item's storage class and freshness), unresolved questions, reopen anchor, and roll-up.
Each roll-up answers what changed, what remains unresolved, and the next safe action, and its headline keeps the storage classes distinct.
The outgoing-shift handoff, client handoff, daily operations digest, and night-shift digest are all present.
The set proves all six canonical object kinds across its groups.
The set proves all four severities across its groups.
Packet, group, evidence, and question ids are unique.
